title: 听力句子填空
goal: 依据句法和逻辑关系提取录音中的原词。

points.label: 根据句法预测所缺成分
提取保持原有逻辑关系的答案

sources.title: 雅思 IELTS Academic：课表
sources.used: 听力句子填空与听力课教学规格

body.p: 句子填空的题干是一个完整的句子，表达定义、因果或比较关系。空格前后的语法和逻辑词决定所缺的成分。

body.box: A wider container loses water more ______ than a narrow one.

body.p: 空格修饰 loses，应填副词。比较的双方是 a wider container 和 a narrow one。

steps.d: 先找出主语、谓语和空格的位置。空格前的限定词或动词可以提示所缺的词性。
根据 because、therefore、than 等词判断句子的关系。分清原因、结果和比较的双方。
在录音里找出与题干意思相同的说法。从中取出既合句法、又合关系的原词。
答案的对象和范围要与录音一致，如 in this trial。词数不超过题面的限制。

cards.title: 句法与关系
rows: Drying is slower because the air is ______.
In this trial, only the small sample was ______.
过去分词，范围由 only 和 in this trial 限定

body.box:
Recording: The uncovered tray dried faster because air could move over its surface.

Air movement made the uncovered tray dry ______.

Write ONE WORD from the recording.

body.p: 答案是 faster。录音用 because，题干用 made 改写同一个因果关系。空气流动是原因，干得更快是结果。

cards.title: 常见错误
rows: tray A dries faster than tray B → Tray ______ dries faster
答案保留 in this trial 的范围

lines.text: A model is a simplified representation of a system.

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. A model is a simplified ______ of a system.
items.why: 录音说 a simplified representation of a system。空格在 simplified 之后，填名词 representation。

lines.text: The surface was rough, so the block moved slowly.

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. The block moved slowly because the surface was ______.
items.why: 录音说 The surface was rough, so the block moved slowly。题干用 because 改写，原因是 rough。

lines.text: The longer route took more time than the shorter route.

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. The longer route required more ______ than the shorter route.
items.why: 录音的 took more time 在题干中改成 required more ______，答案是 time。

lines.text: In this trial the covered jar cooled more slowly than the open jar.

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. In this trial the ______ jar cooled more slowly than the open jar.
items.why: 依据是 the covered jar cooled more slowly than the open jar。降温较慢的是 covered jar。

lines.text: Today we will discuss a classroom comparison of materials that transmit light. A transparent material allows light to pass through so that objects can be seen clearly through it. A translucent material also lets some light through, but an object viewed through it is not seen clearly. The class compared a sheet of clear glass with a sheet of tracing paper. Both sheets were placed between a lamp and a screen. The students first looked through each sheet towards a printed page. The print was clearly visible through the glass, but not through the tracing paper. Next they recorded the light reaching the screen with a meter. For these two samples, the reading behind the glass was higher than the reading behind the tracing paper. The result describes the particular sheets used in the demonstration. It does not establish that every sheet of glass produces the same reading. The light reaching the meter depends on the source and the position of the equipment as well as the material. In this comparison the lamp and meter stayed in fixed positions. The class recorded the type of material, the visibility of the print and the meter reading separately. Keeping these observations distinct makes it possible to compare the samples without treating visibility and the amount of light as identical measures. The record also identifies the lamp used.

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. A transparent material allows ______ to pass through it.
items.why: 定义是 A transparent material allows light to pass through，答案是 light。

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. The print was clearly visible through the ______ in this demonstration.
items.why: 依据是 The print was clearly visible through the glass, but not through the tracing paper。答案是 glass。

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. The meter reading behind the glass was ______ than the reading behind the tracing paper.
items.why: 依据是 the reading behind the glass was higher than the reading behind the tracing paper。答案是 higher。

lines.text: Today we will look at a simple comparison of heat transfer through two containers. Insulation is material used to slow the transfer of heat. In a classroom investigation, one metal container was wrapped in a layer of wool, while another was left uncovered. Both contained the same amount of warm water at the beginning. A thermometer was placed in each container, and the temperatures were measured at the same intervals. After twenty minutes, the water in the wrapped container was warmer than the water in the uncovered one. In this particular comparison, the wool reduced the rate at which the water cooled. The results concern the two containers tested, rather than every possible insulating material. A written record should include the amount of water, the initial temperatures and the timing of each reading. These details help explain what was held constant. If one container had started with hotter water, the later difference would be harder to interpret. The class can present its measurements in a table with a row for each time and a column for each container. It can then describe the pattern without claiming that the temperature remained unchanged. Both containers cooled during the investigation, but their temperatures fell at different rates. The observation and the explanation should be recorded separately: the warmer water was observed, while reduced heat transfer is the explanation offered for the difference.

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. Insulation is material used to slow the transfer of ______.
items.why: 定义是 material used to slow the transfer of heat，答案是 heat。

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. The wrapped container had a layer of ______.
items.why: 依据是 one metal container was wrapped in a layer of wool。答案是 wool。

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. After twenty minutes, the water in the wrapped container was ______ than that in the uncovered container.
items.why: 依据是 the water in the wrapped container was warmer than the water in the uncovered one。答案是 warmer。

lines.text: A field survey can describe the distribution of objects across a study area. Distribution means the way objects are spread over a space. In one teaching exercise, students recorded stones on two marked strips of ground. The strips had equal area, and the class used the same counting rule on both. The first strip was beside a path; the second was further away. Students counted eighteen stones on the first strip and eighty on the second. The counts therefore showed more stones on the second strip in this exercise. Students also measured the length of the largest stone in each strip. On the first strip it was fifteen centimetres long; on the second it was fifty centimetres long. The count and the length are different measurements. A large stone does not itself explain how many stones were present. The class discussed whether movement along the path might have affected the distribution, but this suggestion remained a possible explanation rather than a result of the count. To examine it, another investigation would need additional evidence. The report for this exercise should identify the two strips, give the measurements and describe the limited area surveyed. It should also distinguish the observed difference from any explanation proposed afterwards. A table can place the strip labels in rows and the stone count and maximum length in separate columns. The recorded values then remain attached to the correct locations.

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. Distribution describes how objects are spread over a ______.
items.why: 定义是 the way objects are spread over a space，答案是 space。

items.stem: Write ONE NUMBER. Students counted ______ stones on the first strip.
items.why: 依据是 eighteen stones on the first strip。eighty 是第二条地块的数目。

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. Movement along the path was a possible ______ for the distribution.
items.why: 依据是 this suggestion remained a possible explanation rather than a result of the count。答案是 explanation。
